name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
oracle_text: Each opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until that player has exiled cards with total mana value 20 or greater.
flavor_text: The raging behir reared back, opened its terrible maw . . . and collapsed in a fit of horrifying giggles.

name: Primal Surge
oracle_text: Exile the top card of your library. If it's a permanent card, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you do, repeat this process.
flavor_text: With Avacyn's return, the flow of life became a tidal wave.

name: Thran Tome
oracle_text: {5}, {T}: Reveal the top three cards of your library. Target opponent chooses one of those cards. Put that card into your graveyard, then draw two cards.
flavor_text: Every line holds a tale, and between lie a thousand more.

name: Jace's Mindseeker
oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, target opponent mills five cards. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among them without paying its mana cost.

name: Galvanoth
oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may look at the top card of your library. You may cast it without paying its mana cost if it's an instant or sorcery spell.
flavor_text: It chews open Mirrodin's husk and feeds on the outpouring of energy.

name: Counterbalance
oracle_text: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you do, counter that spell if it has the same mana value as the revealed card.

name: Mind Funeral
oracle_text: Target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until four land cards are revealed. That player puts all cards revealed this way into their graveyard.
flavor_text:
"The soul is only as eternal as I say it is."
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Chaos Harlequin
oracle_text: {R}: Exile the top card of your library. If that card is a land card, this creature gets -4/-0 until end of turn. Otherwise, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

name: Memorial Vault
oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice another artifact: Exile the top X cards of your library, where X is one plus the mana value of the sacrificed artifact. You may play those cards this turn.
flavor_text: Kavaron cannot be saved, but its culture can.

name: Eye of Yawgmoth
oracle_text: {3}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature: Reveal a number of cards from the top of your library equal to the sacrificed creature's power. Put one into your hand and exile the rest.

name: Tahngarth's Glare
oracle_text: Look at the top three cards of target opponent's library, then put them back in any order. That player looks at the top three cards of your library, then puts them back in any order.

name: Fortune's Favor
oracle_text: Target opponent looks at the top four cards of your library and separates them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

name: Powerbalance
oracle_text: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you do, you may cast that card without paying its mana cost if the two spells have the same mana value.
flavor_text: For every action, a reaction. For every force, a firestorm.

name: Guided Passage
oracle_text: Reveal the cards in your library. An opponent chooses from among them a creature card, a land card, and a noncreature, nonland card. You put the chosen cards into your hand. Then shuffle.

name: Amareth, the Lustrous
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever another permanent you control enters, look at the top card of your library. If it shares a card type with that permanent, you may reveal that card and put it into your hand.
flavor_text: "Come closer, dear, and let me see that bauble. I've got a match for it somewhere..."

name: Mitotic Manipulation
oracle_text: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may put one of those cards onto the battlefield if it has the same name as a permanent. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
flavor_text:
"They can't even comprehend nature. How could they improve it?"
—Venser

name: Lord of the Void
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, exile the top seven cards of that player's library, then put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield under your control.

name: Allure of the Unknown
oracle_text: Reveal the top six cards of your library. An opponent exiles a nonland card from among them, then you put the rest into your hand. That opponent may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
flavor_text: The light of hope blinded Pantor to the ills of the world.

name: Bioplasm
oracle_text: Whenever this creature attacks, exile the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, this creature gets +X/+Y until end of turn, where X is the exiled creature card's power and Y is its toughness.

name: Scroll Rack
oracle_text: {1}, {T}: Exile any number of cards from your hand face down. Put that many cards from the top of your library into your hand. Then look at the exiled cards and put them on top of your library in any order.

name: Atris, Oracle of Half-Truths
oracle_text:
Menace
When Atris enters, target opponent looks at the top three cards of your library and separates them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

name: Dream Harvest
oracle_text: Each opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they have exiled cards with total mana value 5 or greater this way. Until end of turn, you may cast cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
flavor_text: Faeries swarm to snoring boggarts like vultures to rotting meat.

name: Over the Top
oracle_text: Each player reveals a number of cards from the top of their library equal to the number of nonland permanents they control, puts all permanent cards they revealed this way onto the battlefield, and puts the rest into their graveyard.

name: Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers
oracle_text:
Trample, haste
Whenever Raph & Mikey attack, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

oracle_text:

I — You may draw a card for each artifact you control. If you do, each opponent draws a card.
II — Artifact spells you cast this turn cost {1} less to cast.
III — This Saga deals X damage to target opponent, where X is the greatest mana value among artifacts you control.

name: Elspeth Conquers Death
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)

II — Noncreature spells your opponents cast cost {2} more to cast until your next turn.

oracle_text:

II — Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
III — Target opponent may sacrifice a nonland, nontoken permanent of their choice. If they don't, they lose 2 life and you draw a card.

oracle_text:

name: Origin of Captain America
oracle_text:

I — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains first strike and vigilance until end of turn.

III — Tap up to one target creature and put a stun counter on it.

name: Harald Unites the Elves
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)

III — Whenever an Elf you control attacks this turn, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

name: Fall of the First Civilization
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You and target opponent each draw two cards.
II — Exile target artifact an opponent controls.
III — Each player chooses three nonland permanents they control. Destroy all other nonland permanents.

oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Mill three cards. You may put a historic card from among them into your hand. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
IV — Historic spells you cast this turn cost {2} less to cast.
